notes.title: Widescreen Update coming soon!
notes.content: After many many years Cursed 2 is finally going widescreen! I have to extend all backgrounds and adjust all object placement to accomodate it, but it hasn't proven to be too hard yet. I want all new players this fall to have the best possible experience, along with some minor graphical tweaks and improvements. I'm not sure if the BONUS menu option will roll out with this or not yet, but i will keep workin on it.
